text_block_list.text:
Suzuka! What can I do to improve my
runaway
skills like you?
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text: Um...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Ooh! I wanna know too!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ Б

text_block_list.text:
I always simply run as fast as I can. I
don't think
there's any special trick...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Aw, come on! You can tell us!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text: (Wh-what should I tell them?)
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Umm... Maybe you could practice your
incline
running by taking a trip up a
mountain—
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: A mountain?!
text_block_list.name: Умамусумэ А

text_block_list.text: (It's hard to put this stuff into words...)
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Suzuka! My dream is to be able to run
like you.
Could I ask what your secret is?
text_block_list.name: Umamusume C

text_block_list.text: My secret? Um... Well...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
(If only someone could give me the
secret to
giving good advice...)
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Sigh...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
(I should be safe from any questions
here.)
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
(I'm already exhausted and training
hasn't even
started.)
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
(Maybe I'll find some good pictures of
some
snowy landscapes. That should get
my spirits back
up.)
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
(Hehe. It looks so quiet and chilly. How

pleasant...)
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: (Hm... I'm starting to feel a little sleepy.)
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text: Zzz... zzz... zzz...
text_block_list.name: Сайленс Судзука

text_block_list.text:
Сайленс Судзука begins arriving late to
training
frequently.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
